title: [BUG] Can't login with my Team account
body:
I have my Organization Team account created for me.


Whenever I run Claude Code - it asks me for to choose login method:

```
 Select login method:

 ❯ 1. Claude account with subscription
    Pro, Max, Team, or Enterprise

   2. Anthropic Console account
    API usage billing
```

And when I choose 1 - I got redirected to that page. Which suggest me to use option 2) which is not what I want.


```
Hey! We see you have a Teams subscription!
To log into Claude Code with Teams, start Claude Code and login with “2. Anthropic Console account.”
```
author: slyapustin
